name: Grandma's Garden of Crystals
source:
It is a fairytale about crystal flowers and the magical guardian of the world.


Look at those flowers: their wispy haulm shivering. 

Soon will they bloom, and turn into crystal. 

The world is protected by them, by the power of crystal. 

And you are owner of the garden, as well as the guardian of the world. 

In the past 80-years life, the flowers sprout and grow.


Finally, they are blooming. It is time to harvest.

---

In memory of the author's grandma Wang Lan-ying, a kind and chatty woman who devoted decades of her life as a teacher of the elementary school of town. She stopped her years of suffering from lung cancer in peace, after the first few hours of 2023, before the dawn.

In her last years, she always complained about not hearing clearly, and rested a lot on the bed. She was busy saving the world at somewhere beyond, making her tired, and often too far away to hear the voice from this world. That was the original idea of this game.

She's a super hero. She planted so many beautiful things in her life, and here came the harvest.

[Edited from [url=https://xlores-liang.itch.io/grandmas-garden-of-crystals]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
这是一则关于水晶花与世界魔法守护者的童话。

看那些花朵：纤细的花茎正轻轻颤动。

很快，它们就会绽放，化作水晶。

这个世界正受到它们——受到水晶力量的庇护。

而你是这座花园的主人，也是这个世界的守护者。

在过去80年的人生岁月里，花朵发芽、生长。

如今，它们终于迎来了盛开。收获的时刻到了。

——

谨以此作纪念作者的奶奶王兰英——一位善良健谈的女性，将自己数十年的心血奉献给了镇上的小学教育事业。2023年刚过去几个小时、黎明尚未到来之际，她在平静中结束了多年来受肺癌折磨的苦痛。

在生命的最后几年里，她总抱怨听不清声音，大部分时间都卧床休养。那是因为她正忙着在彼岸的某处拯救世界，所以才会如此疲惫，也常常因为离得太远而听不清这个世界的声音——这便是本游戏的最初构想。

她是一位超级英雄。她在一生中播下了那么多美好的事物，而如今，收获的季节到了。

[整编自[url=https://xlores-liang.itch.io/grandmas-garden-of-crystals]Itch.io[/url]]
